notes.title: Demo release.
notes.notes:
Good news for all those who wanted to try Grandmaster's Revenge as soon as possible.

A new demo is out. So far, the demo is only available in English and Russian. Other languages will be added later. We recommend playing at 1080i as the interface has been adapted specifically for it. You can save your progress in the Main menu.

The demo gives you the opportunity to fully play the Tutorial campaign, start the Story campaign, try out most of the game mechanics from the main game. Try out 3 Whitehills clans out of 23.

We estimate that the initial familiarization with the new features and mechanics of the game will take you about five hours.

We also released a new trailer.
